sub.en: Arrest, CPR, the AED, choking, oxygen

hook.en: No pulse, no real breathing: push hard, push fast, keep going.
hook.zh: 没脉搏、没有真正的呼吸：用力按、快速按、别停。

say.en: Check breathing and the pulse together, 10 seconds at most. No pulse and no breathing, or only gasps: start CPR now.
say.zh: 呼吸和脉搏一起查，最多 10 秒。没脉搏、没呼吸，或者只有喘息：马上开始 CPR。

say.en: 100–120 a minute, 5.0–6.0 cm deep, full recoil, 30:2 with one or two rescuers, pauses under 5 seconds.
say.zh: 每分钟 100–120 次，深 5.0–6.0 cm，完全回弹，单人双人都是 30:2，中断不超过 5 秒。

say.en: A verifiable DNR or No CPR order means you don't start. And never compress a patient who has a pulse.
say.zh: 有可核实的 DNR 或 No CPR 医嘱就不开始。病人有脉搏，绝对不要按。

stem.en: A 50-year-old man collapses at a Richmond bus stop. No palpable pulse, but he takes occasional gasping breaths.
stem.zh: 一名 50 岁男性在列治文的公交站倒地。触不到脉搏，但偶有喘息样呼吸。

opts.en: Cardiac arrest: start CPR
He's breathing, so no CPR yet
opts.zh: 他还有呼吸，暂不需要 CPR

opts.en: Oxygen by mask, then watch him
Wait 2 minutes, then reassess

why.en: No pulse with absent or gasping breathing is cardiac arrest. Start CPR 30:2 and get the AED on as soon as possible.
why.zh: 没脉搏、没呼吸或只有喘息，就是心搏骤停。开始 CPR 30:2，尽快贴上 AED。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40 (Adult CPR/AED)

ask.en: Deciding whether an adult is in arrest: how do you check breathing and pulse?
ask.zh: 判断成人是否心搏骤停时，呼吸和脉搏怎么查？

opts.en: Together, 10 seconds at most
Breathing 15 s, then pulse 15 s
opts.zh: 先查呼吸 15 秒，再摸脉 15 秒

opts.en: Pulse only: breathing doesn't matter
A full minute, to be sure

why.en: Both at once, no more than 10 seconds. Checking one after the other only delays the first compression.
why.zh: 两项同时查，最多 10 秒。一项一项轮着查，只会推迟第一次按压。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40 (Adult CPR/AED)

stem.en: Kelowna care home: an 88-year-old woman is in cardiac arrest. Staff hand you a valid, verifiable DNR order.
stem.zh: 基隆拿一家护理院：一名 88 岁女性心搏骤停。工作人员递给你一份有效、可核实的 DNR 医嘱。

opts.en: Don't start CPR
CPR anyway until a doctor arrives
opts.zh: 照样做 CPR，等医生到场

opts.en: Compressions only, no breaths
AED on, but never press shock
opts.zh: 贴上 AED，但不按电击键

why.en: The one listed contraindication to CPR/AED is a verifiable DNR or No CPR order. Verifiable is the key word.
why.zh: CPR/AED 唯一列出的禁忌证就是可核实的 DNR 或 No CPR 医嘱。关键词是「可核实」。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40 (Adult CPR/AED)

stem.en: You and your partner start CPR on a 66-year-old on a Surrey kitchen floor.
stem.zh: 你和搭档在素里一户人家的厨房地上，给一位 66 岁老人做 CPR。

ask.zh: 按压与通气的比例是多少？

opts.en: 30:2, one or two rescuers
20:2 with two rescuers
5:1 at all times
3:1 with two rescuers

why.en: Adults are 30:2 whether there are one or two of you.
why.zh: 成人不管一个人还是两个人，都是 30:2。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.43 (Adult CPR/AED Basics)

stem.en: Your partner is compressing an average-sized 58-year-old man in a Kamloops hotel lobby.
stem.zh: 搭档正在甘露市一家酒店大堂，给一名普通体型的 58 岁男子按压。

opts.en: 5.0 to 6.0 cm
2.0 to 3.0 cm
3.0 to 4.0 cm
At least 8.0 cm

why.en: 5.0 to 6.0 cm in a normal adult; for smaller or bigger patients, 1/3 to 1/2 of the chest diameter. Full recoil every time.
why.zh: 普通成人 5.0 至 6.0 cm；体型偏小或偏大，按胸廓前后径的 1/3 到 1/2。每次都要完全回弹。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.43 (Adult CPR/AED Basics)

ask.en: Interruptions in compressions: keep each one under how long?
ask.zh: 胸外按压的中断，每次要控制在多少秒以内？

opts.en: 5 seconds
15 seconds
20 seconds
30 seconds

why.en: Under 5 seconds. Only the first pulse-and-breathing check gets up to 10.
why.zh: 不超过 5 秒。只有一开始那次呼吸脉搏检查可以用到 10 秒。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.42 (CPR/AED Basic concepts)

ask.en: Which belong to high-quality adult CPR on the exam?
ask.zh: 哪些属于考试要的成人高质量 CPR？

right.zh: 每 2 分钟换一个人按

wrong.en: Slow to 80 a minute to save energy
wrong.zh: 放慢到每分钟 80 次，省点力气

wrong.en: A long pause every cycle to feel for a pulse
wrong.zh: 每个循环停下来长时间摸脉

why.en: Rate 100–120, full recoil, no hyperventilating, a fresh compressor every 2 minutes. Pulse checks belong to the analysis, not every cycle.
why.zh: 频率 100–120，完全回弹，不过度通气，每 2 分钟换人。摸脉放在 AED 分析时，不是每个循环都停。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.42–43 (CPR/AED Basic concepts; Adult CPR/AED Basics)

stem.en: Abbotsford mall: a 62-year-old who fainted is now moaning, breathing on his own, radial pulse strong. A bystander kneels to start compressions.
stem.zh: 阿伯茨福德一家商场：一名 62 岁男子晕倒，现在在呻吟，自己在呼吸，桡动脉搏动有力。一位路人跪下准备按压。

bad.en: Compressing a patient who has a pulse fails the station outright.
bad.zh: 给有脉搏的病人按压，考站直接不过。

why.en: He has a pulse and is breathing: no CPR. Compressing a patient who has a pulse is the grading's own example of jeopardizing life.
why.zh: 他有脉搏、在呼吸：不做 CPR。给有脉搏的病人按压，正是评分标准里「危及生命」的原例。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.36 (Overall Patient Care)

s.en: At the start of an arrest, hook the oxygen to the BVM before you give the first breath.
s.zh: 骤停一开始，先把氧气接到球囊面罩上，再给第一口气。

why.en: Breaths first, then connect the oxygen. Delaying ventilation to hook up oxygen is a deduction; never connecting it is another.
why.zh: 先通气，再接氧。为接氧推迟通气要扣分；一直不接氧，又是另一项扣分。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.30 (Breathing Management)

title.en: The AED, and when to stop

hook.en: Pads on early, push through the charge, back on the chest after every analysis.
hook.zh: 电极片早贴，充电时照按，每次分析完立刻回到胸口。

k.zh: 终止：有过 ROSC 或电击

say.en: Position the AED and analyze as soon as possible. Keep compressing while it charges; hands off only to analyze and shock.
say.zh: 尽早贴好 AED 并分析。充电时继续按压；只有分析和电击的那一下才离手。

big.en: Shock or not, back to CPR

say.en: Shock advised: shock, then 2 minutes of CPR. No shock advised: CPR at once. Then analyze and repeat.
say.zh: 提示电击：电击后 CPR 2 分钟。不建议电击：立刻 CPR。然后再分析，循环往复。

say.en: No ROSC and no shocks: you may stop at 30 minutes, consulting medical oversight. Any ROSC or any shock: keep going to 40.
say.zh: 从未 ROSC、从未电击：30 分钟可以停，要先咨询医疗监督。有过 ROSC 或电击：做到 40 分钟。

stem.en: You're compressing on a 74-year-old in a Penticton church hall when your partner arrives with the AED.
stem.zh: 你正在彭蒂克顿一间教堂礼堂里给一位 74 岁老人按压，搭档带着 AED 赶到。

ask.en: When does the AED go on?

opts.en: Now: pads on, analyze without delay
After 10 minutes of CPR
opts.zh: 做满 10 分钟 CPR 之后

opts.en: Only if 4 cycles of CPR fail
opts.zh: 4 个循环 CPR 无效才用

opts.en: Only once paramedics arrive

why.en: Position the AED and analyze as soon as possible. Early CPR and early defibrillation go together; neither should hold up the other.
why.zh: 尽早贴好 AED 并分析。早 CPR 和早除颤并行，谁也不该耽误谁。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40, p.42 (Adult CPR/AED; Basic concepts)

stem.en: At a Nanaimo hockey rink, the AED advises a shock for a 52-year-old in cardiac arrest.
stem.zh: 纳奈莫一座冰球场，AED 提示给一名 52 岁心搏骤停患者电击。

opts.en: CPR at once for 2 minutes, then analyze
opts.zh: 立即 CPR 2 分钟，再分析

opts.en: Pulse check for 30 s, then CPR if absent
opts.zh: 先摸脉 30 秒，没有再按

opts.en: Analyze again at once, shock until ROSC
opts.zh: 立刻再分析，反复电击直到 ROSC

opts.en: Ventilate 1 minute before compressing
opts.zh: 先通气 1 分钟再按压

why.en: Single shock, then straight back to 2 minutes of CPR, then analyze. Keep compressing while it charges.
why.zh: 单次电击，然后立刻回去做 2 分钟 CPR，再分析。充电时也要继续按。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40, p.43 (Adult CPR/AED; Adult CPR/AED Basics)

stem.en: The AED says 'no shock advised' for a 70-year-old on a Langford living-room floor.
stem.zh: 兰福德一户人家客厅地上，AED 对一位 70 岁患者提示「不建议电击」。

opts.en: Resume CPR at once; analyze again after 2 minutes
opts.zh: 立即恢复 CPR，2 分钟后再分析

opts.en: Stop: no shock means no chance
opts.zh: 停止：不建议电击就是没希望了

opts.en: Re-stick the pads, then reanalyze
opts.zh: 把电极片重贴一遍再分析

opts.en: Give a precordial thump

why.en: No shock advised means resume CPR immediately: 2 minutes, analyze, repeat. It is never a reason to stop.
why.zh: 不建议电击，就立刻恢复 CPR：2 分钟、分析、再循环。这从来不是停止的理由。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40, p.43 (Adult CPR/AED; Adult CPR/AED Basics)

stem.en: Alone with an AED, you find a 30-year-old in cardiac arrest in a Vancouver alley: an apparent opioid overdose.
stem.zh: 你独自带着 AED，在温哥华一条小巷里发现一名 30 岁心搏骤停患者，看起来是阿片类药物过量。

ask.zh: 先做 CPR 还是先上 AED？

opts.en: 5 cycles of CPR (about 2 minutes), then the AED
opts.zh: 先做 5 个循环 CPR（约 2 分钟），再贴 AED

opts.en: AED first, analyze before any CPR
opts.zh: 先贴 AED 分析，再做 CPR

opts.en: Naloxone 纳洛酮 first; CPR can wait
opts.zh: 先给 naloxone 纳洛酮，CPR 可以等

opts.en: Breaths only: overdoses don't need compressions
opts.zh: 只通气：药物过量不需要按压

why.en: Overdose is an asphyxia arrest, driven by hypoxia. Alone with an AED: 5 cycles of CPR, about 2 minutes, before applying it.
why.zh: 药物过量属于窒息性骤停，根源是缺氧。独自带着 AED：先做 5 个循环 CPR（约 2 分钟），再贴 AED。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.44 (Asphyxia arrest)

s.en: Two rescuers, asphyxia arrest: the AED goes on during one-person CPR and analyzes after 5 cycles.
s.zh: 两名施救者、窒息性骤停：一人做 CPR 的同时贴上 AED，5 个循环后再分析。

why.en: One does CPR while the other applies the AED; analyze after 5 cycles, about 2 minutes. That is the choking-arrest sequence.
why.zh: 一个人按，另一个人贴 AED；5 个循环（约 2 分钟）后分析。噎食骤停就是这个流程。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.44 (Asphyxia arrest)

s.en: Hands off the chest as soon as the AED starts charging.
s.zh: AED 一开始充电，手就离开胸口。

why.en: Compress through the charge; hands off only to analyze and shock. Not compressing while it charges is a grading deduction.
why.zh: 充电时照按，只有分析和放电时才离手。充电时不按压，评分会扣分。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.43; Grading Criteria p.31 (CPR/AED)

stem.en: 30 minutes of CPR on a 79-year-old in a Prince George home. No ROSC at any point; the AED never advised a shock.
stem.zh: 乔治王子城一户人家，给一位 79 岁老人做了 30 分钟 CPR。全程没有 ROSC，AED 从未建议电击。

opts.en: Stopping: 30 minutes, no ROSC, no shocks
opts.zh: 可以终止：30 分钟、无 ROSC、未电击

opts.en: CPR must go on to 60 minutes
CPR may stop only at hospital
It should have stopped at 10 minutes

why.en: 30 minutes with no ROSC and no defibrillations meets the stop rule. Consult medical oversight to discontinue at the scene.
why.zh: 30 分钟、无 ROSC、从未除颤，符合终止标准。现场终止前要咨询医疗监督。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40, p.42 (Adult CPR/AED; Basic concepts)

stem.en: A 68-year-old in Kamloops arrested 32 minutes ago. Two early shocks, never any ROSC. Your partner wants to stop at 30.
stem.zh: 甘露市一名 68 岁患者 32 分钟前骤停。早期电击过两次，从没 ROSC。搭档想在 30 分钟时停。

opts.en: Continue: shocks were given, so go to 40 minutes
opts.zh: 继续：电击过，要做到 40 分钟

opts.en: Stop now: 30 minutes applies to every arrest
opts.zh: 现在停：30 分钟适用于所有骤停

opts.en: Stop only if the family agrees
CPR should have stopped after the second shock

why.en: The 30-minute stop needs no ROSC and no defibrillations. Any ROSC or any shock moves it to 40 minutes.
why.zh: 30 分钟终止的前提是无 ROSC 且未除颤。只要有过 ROSC 或电击，就延到 40 分钟。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40 (Adult CPR/AED)

ask.en: Which of these end CPR/AED on the exam?
ask.zh: 考试里哪些情况可以结束 CPR/AED？

right.en: Care handed to more advanced providers
right.zh: 移交给更高级的救护人员

right.en: Signs of life: movement, coughing, breathing
right.zh: 出现生命迹象：活动、咳嗽、呼吸

right.en: You're shown a valid DNR or No CPR order
right.zh: 有人出示有效的 DNR 或 No CPR 医嘱

wrong.en: The AED says no shock advised

wrong.zh: 已经做了 10 分钟仍无 ROSC

why.en: Continue until care is transferred, signs of life appear, a valid DNR is presented, or the 30/40-minute rule is met.
why.zh: 一直做到：移交、出现生命迹象、有人出示有效 DNR，或满足 30/40 分钟规则。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40, p.43 (Adult CPR/AED; Adult CPR/AED Basics)

ask.en: Shock advised: put the cycle in order.
ask.zh: 提示电击：把这一轮的步骤排好顺序。

why.en: Analyze, compress through the charge, shock, straight back to 2 minutes of CPR, analyze. Repeat.
why.zh: 分析、充电时照按、电击、立刻回到 2 分钟 CPR、再分析。循环往复。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.40, p.43 (Adult CPR/AED; Adult CPR/AED Basics)

hook.en: Good cough: coach it. No cough: thrust. No response: compress.
hook.zh: 咳得有力：鼓励咳。咳不出：冲击。没反应：按压。

v.en: thrusts / back slaps, sets of five
v.zh: 冲击 / 拍背，每组五次
按 30 次，打开气道查看

say.en: A forceful cough moves air: coach it and stay close. Thrusts start when he can't cough, speak or breathe.
say.zh: 用力咳嗽说明还有气流：鼓励他咳，守在旁边。咳不出、说不出、喘不上气时，才开始冲击。

say.en: Back slaps, abdominal thrusts and chest thrusts all work. Alternate two in sets of five; chest thrusts if abdominal thrusts aren't working.
say.zh: 拍背、腹部冲击、胸部冲击都有效。两种手法五次一组交替；腹部冲击不奏效就改胸部冲击。

say.en: Lower him and start compressions with no pulse check. After 30, open the airway and look. Remove only what you can see.
say.zh: 放他躺下，直接按压，不摸脉。按 30 次后打开气道查看。只取出看得见的东西。

stem.en: Kelowna restaurant: a 45-year-old inhaled a piece of steak. He coughs forcefully and can speak between coughs.
stem.zh: 基隆拿一家餐厅：一名 45 岁男子误吸了一块牛排。他在用力咳嗽，咳嗽间隙还能说话。

opts.en: Encourage the cough and watch closely
opts.zh: 鼓励他用力咳，密切观察

opts.en: Abdominal thrusts right away
A finger sweep to find the meat
Lie him down and start compressions

why.en: Partial obstruction with a good cough: have him cough forcefully. Thrusts are for a full obstruction.
why.zh: 部分梗阻、咳嗽有力：让他用力咳。冲击是留给完全梗阻的。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction)

stem.en: Suddenly he can't speak, cough or breathe, and clutches his throat. He is still conscious.
stem.zh: 他突然不能说话、咳不出、喘不上气，双手掐住喉咙，但仍然清醒。

opts.en: Back slaps and thrusts, sets of five
opts.zh: 拍背与冲击，五次一组交替

opts.en: Wait until he passes out
Sips of water to wash it down
A blind finger sweep

why.en: Full obstruction in a conscious adult: chest thrusts, back slaps and abdominal thrusts all work. Alternating two in sets of five is acceptable.
why.zh: 清醒成人完全梗阻：胸部冲击、拍背、腹部冲击都有效。两种手法五次一组交替是可以的。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction)

stem.en: A conscious 32-year-old late in pregnancy is choking in a Victoria café. Abdominal thrusts aren't appropriate or working.
stem.zh: 维多利亚一家咖啡馆，一名 32 岁、妊娠晚期的清醒孕妇噎住了。腹部冲击不合适，也没奏效。

opts.en: Consider chest thrusts
Wait for it to clear on its own
Offer water between attempts
Sweep blindly with a finger

why.en: If abdominal thrusts aren't effective, consider chest thrusts. Chest thrusts are a listed technique for severe obstruction anyway.
why.zh: 腹部冲击不奏效，就考虑胸部冲击。胸部冲击本来就是重度梗阻列出的手法之一。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction)

stem.en: A choking 77-year-old in a Nanaimo diner goes limp and unresponsive while you're giving abdominal thrusts.
stem.zh: 纳奈莫一家小餐馆，一位 77 岁老人噎住，你做腹部冲击时他瘫软下去、没了反应。

opts.en: Lower him and start compressions, no pulse check
opts.zh: 放他躺下，直接按压，不摸脉

opts.en: Check his pulse for a full 60 seconds first
Keep doing abdominal thrusts on the floor
Back slaps only

why.en: Collapse means CPR starting with compressions, no pulse check. After 30 compressions, open the airway and look before the breaths.
why.zh: 一倒地就从按压开始 CPR，不摸脉。按压 30 次后打开气道查看，再吹气。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction)

ask.en: During CPR for an obstructed airway, when may you sweep the mouth with your fingers?
ask.zh: 气道梗阻做 CPR 时，什么情况下可以用手指清理口腔？

opts.en: Only when you can see the object
Before every breath, seen or not
opts.zh: 每次通气前都清，不管看没看到

opts.en: Whenever the breaths feel hard
opts.zh: 只要通气感觉困难就清

opts.en: Never, even when you can see it
opts.zh: 绝不清理，看到了也不取

why.en: No blind sweeps, ever. Look in the mouth before you ventilate and remove the object only if you see it.
why.zh: 永远不要盲目掏挖。通气前先看口腔，只有看到异物才取出。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction)

stem.en: Unwitnessed: a 60-year-old lies unconscious and apneic in a Richmond food court, suspected choking. Your first breath won't go in.
stem.zh: 无人目击：列治文一处美食广场，一名 60 岁男子昏迷、无呼吸，疑似噎食。你的第一口气吹不进去。

opts.en: Reposition and retry; still no air: compressions
opts.zh: 重新摆头位再试；仍不进气：开始按压

opts.en: Abdominal thrusts on the supine patient
opts.zh: 对仰卧的他做腹部冲击

opts.en: Suction the airway for 60 seconds
Roll him into the recovery position

why.en: Reposition the head and try again. Still no air entry: start compressions and keep 30:2, looking in the mouth before each ventilation.
why.zh: 重新摆正头位再试。仍然吹不进：开始按压，保持 30:2，每次通气前看口腔。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Unwitnessed Unconscious FBAO)

ask.en: Full obstruction, conscious adult: which techniques does EMALB list?
ask.zh: 清醒成人完全梗阻：EMALB 列出了哪些手法？

wrong.en: Sips of water to wash it down

why.en: All three are feasible and effective in conscious adults. Blind finger sweeps are banned outright.
why.zh: 三种手法对清醒的成人都可行有效。盲目手指探查是明令禁止的。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Foreign Body Airway Obstruction)

s.en: When you suction an adult's airway, each pass lasts 10–15 seconds.
s.zh: 给成人吸引气道，每次吸 10–15 秒。

why.en: Adult: 10–15 seconds. On a choking call, suction, the AED and the BVM come to the patient's side.
why.zh: 成人每次 10–15 秒。噎食呼救，吸引器、AED 和球囊面罩都要拿到病人身边。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.45–46 (Suctioning; Foreign Body Airway Obstruction)

ask.en: He collapses. Put the next steps in order.
ask.zh: 他倒地了。把接下来的步骤排好顺序。

steps.en: Remove the object only if seen

steps.zh: 尝试吹 2 口气，继续循环

why.en: Compressions first, then look, then breathe. Check the airway every cycle.
why.zh: 先按，再看，再吹气。每个循环都检查气道。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.46 (Witness Conscious to Unconscious FBAO)

hook.en: Short of breath, shock or smoke: high flow, whatever the number says.
hook.zh: 呼吸困难、休克、烟雾吸入：高流量给氧，不看读数。

big.en: Match the flow to the device

say.en: A face mask never runs under 6 L/min. A non-rebreather runs at 15. Comfortable COPD: nasal cannula at 1–3 L/min.
say.zh: 普通面罩流量绝不低于 6 升/分。非重复呼吸面罩开 15。状态平稳的慢阻肺：鼻导管 1–3 升/分。

say.en: Titrate to 94% only if the patient is not short of breath and not in shock. SOB, shock, CO or smoke: high flow.
say.zh: 只有既不气促、也不休克时，才滴定到 94%。呼吸困难、休克、一氧化碳或烟雾吸入：高流量。

say.en: Non-rebreather at 15, add a nasal cannula underneath at 15, then assist with the BVM. CPAP is a PCP skill.
say.zh: 非重复呼吸面罩开 15，下面再加鼻导管开 15，然后用球囊面罩辅助通气。CPAP 是 PCP 的技能。

ask.en: Why is an adult face mask never run below 6 L/min?
ask.zh: 为什么成人普通面罩的流量绝不能低于 6 升/分？

opts.en: It would give less oxygen than room air
opts.zh: 给氧还不如室内空气多

opts.en: The mask would overheat
Lower flows waste oxygen
It damages the regulator

why.en: Under 6 L/min, exhaled CO2 builds up in the mask and the patient gets less oxygen than room air.
why.zh: 低于 6 升/分，呼出的二氧化碳积在面罩里，病人吸到的氧还不如室内空气。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.50 (Oxygen Administration)

stem.en: A 73-year-old with COPD in a Vernon care home is comfortable, not short of breath, and needs oxygen for the transfer.
stem.zh: 弗农一家护理院，一位 73 岁慢阻肺患者状态平稳、没有呼吸困难，转运途中需要吸氧。

opts.en: Nasal cannula at 1–3 L/min
Non-rebreather at 15 L/min, always
opts.zh: 始终用 15 升/分非重复呼吸面罩

opts.en: Face mask at 4 L/min
None: COPD patients never get oxygen
opts.zh: 不给：慢阻肺患者绝不能吸氧

why.en: Comfortable COPD: nasal cannula at 1–3 L/min. A COPD patient who is short of breath gets high flow.
why.zh: 平稳的慢阻肺：鼻导管 1–3 升/分。慢阻肺患者如果呼吸困难，要给高流量。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.50 (Oxygen Administration)

ask.en: Not short of breath, not in shock: titrate oxygen to what SpO2?
ask.zh: 既无呼吸困难也无休克：氧疗滴定到多少血氧？

opts.en: 100% at all times

why.en: Titrate to 94% when the patient isn't short of breath or in shock. SOB, shock and CO poisoning get high flow.
why.zh: 没有呼吸困难、没有休克时，滴定到 94%。呼吸困难、休克、一氧化碳中毒都给高流量。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.50 (Oxygen Administration)

stem.en: A 38-year-old cyclist hit by a car in Langley is pale, cool and tachycardic. SpO2 reads 95%.
stem.zh: 兰里一名 38 岁骑车人被汽车撞倒，皮肤苍白发凉、心动过速。血氧显示 95%。

opts.en: High flow: shock needs it, whatever the SpO2
opts.zh: 高流量：休克不看血氧都要给

opts.en: None: he's above 94%
Nasal cannula at 1 L/min
Titrate down until it reads 94%

why.en: Shock means high-flow oxygen regardless of the reading. Titrating to 94% is only for patients who aren't SOB or in shock.
why.zh: 休克就给高流量，不管读数多少。滴定到 94% 只适用于没有呼吸困难、没有休克的病人。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.50 (Oxygen Administration)

stem.en: An 80-year-old in severe distress in Chilliwack stays hypoxic, LOC falling, on a non-rebreather plus nasal cannula, both at 15 L/min.
stem.zh: 奇利瓦克一位 80 岁重度呼吸窘迫患者，非重复呼吸面罩加鼻导管（都开 15 升/分）仍缺氧，意识在下降。

ask.en: Your next step as an EMR?

opts.en: Assist ventilations with the BVM
Apply CPAP: any licence level may
opts.zh: 上 CPAP：任何级别都可以

opts.en: Turn the oxygen down to protect the lungs
Wait for the SpO2 to improve

why.en: After maximal oxygen come CPAP, which is a PCP skill, and assisted ventilations. For an EMR the BVM is the next step.
why.zh: 最大量给氧之后，是 CPAP（PCP 的技能）或辅助通气。EMR 的下一步就是球囊面罩。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.50 (Oxygen Administration)

ask.en: Which are listed indications for oxygen in the primary survey?
ask.zh: 初步检查中，哪些是列出的给氧指征？

why.en: Altered LOC, respiratory distress, trauma, shock and hypoxia NYD. Distress alone is enough: don't wait for cyanosis.
why.zh: 意识改变、呼吸窘迫、创伤、休克、原因不明的缺氧。有呼吸窘迫就够了，别等发绀。

items.src: EMALB Exam Guidelines p.11 (Primary Survey Interventions)

s.en: A non-rebreather at 6 L/min is fine if the patient looks comfortable.
s.zh: 病人看起来挺舒服的话，非重复呼吸面罩开 6 升/分也可以。

why.en: Too little flow for the device is the grading's own example: NRB on 6 lpm. A non-rebreather runs at 15 L/min.
why.zh: 流量配不上装置，正是评分标准里的原例：非重复呼吸面罩开 6 升/分。非重复呼吸面罩要开 15 升/分。

items.src: EMALB Grading Criteria p.17 (Oxygen); Exam Guidelines p.50

ask.en: The SpO2 won't come up. Put the escalation in order.
ask.zh: 血氧上不去。把升级步骤排好顺序。

steps.en: Titrate the flow up to 15 L/min

steps.zh: 换非重复呼吸面罩 15 升/分

steps.en: Add a nasal cannula at 15 L/min underneath
steps.zh: 面罩下加鼻导管 15 升/分

why.en: Titrate, non-rebreather, cannula underneath, then CPAP for PCPs or assisted ventilations. Record the SpO2 at each change.
why.zh: 调流量、换非重复呼吸面罩、下面加鼻导管，然后 PCP 上 CPAP 或辅助通气。每一步都记录血氧变化。
